Job Summary: 

 The Product Team is seeking a motivated Product Engineer to be a multi-disciplinary European technical resource. The Product Engineer will directly work for the Product Team interfacing with Sales and Customers on advanced AI driven robotic picking solutions for warehouses. This role will help manage a Show Room, Demo and Test site in Amsterdam and conduct pre-sales and post-sales customer site visits. Success in this role requires a passion to work across disciplines and to support internal and external customers.

 



 Location 

 Amsterdam (Haarlem), Netherlands. 

  

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Lead European Demo and Test site for Robotic Picking
 
 Coordinate visits to BG Amsterdam

 Lead tours and in-depth product demonstrations

 


 Conduct customer site pre-sale visits
 
 Evaluate customer requirements vs technology

 Conduct customer tests at Amsterdam demo site under direction of Go To Market team

 


 Perform visits to existing and ramping Customer sites
 
 Analysis and expert investigations for onsite issues

 Interact with operating teams

 Complete data analysis to increase value at existing sites

 


 
  

 Minimum Qualifications:

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Math, Economics, a related field or strong computer science skills.

 Ability to present findings and build consensus.

 Presentation and public speaking

 2+ years of experience with warehouse logistics, automation or industrial robotics.

 Experience working on teams bringing products to market or a start-up.

 Trouble shooting and root cause analysis

 Fluent Dutch and English

 
  

 Preferred Qualifications:

 
 German, French language skills

 5+ years work in the industrial product sector.

 Customer facing sales or sales support experience

 Expert knowledge of warehouse operations or industrial robotics.

 Practical experience in one or more of the following areas:
 
 Robotic manipulation

 Sortation and conveyor

 Vision systems and sensors

 


 Feasibility studies and proposals

 Entrepreneurial or early-stage company experience

 Data analysis using Python

 Working knowledge of ROS, Linux, Kubernetes

 Professional presentation and collateral creation

 
  

 Other Requirements 

 
 Ability to travel 30%+ within Europe, primarily Western Europe mostly day trips or single overnight

 Visa sponsorship not available for this role
